sources.title: Oregon State University — historical blackberry releases
sources.enumerated_scope: All 19 bullet entries in the Blackberry subsection of Publications & Varieties Released; code/name pairs are one observed entry each.
sources.limitations: Historical list ends with 2015 releases; not a complete current or lifetime portfolio. Release years are source assertions, not publication dates or approved release metadata. Several entries credit other institutions; publication on this site does not assign OSU or USDA breeding, ownership or licensing roles. PPAF and patent references are historical wording, not current legal status. No inferred code aliases, growing regions, traits, canonical entities or image permission. The original accordion link changed the fragment but did not visibly expand in the browser; its original DOM text and the web reader independently supplied the same 45 entries.
